faqs.question: What machining tolerance can SONNE achieve for high-frequency parts?
faqs.answer: For suitable structures above 40 GHz, mechanical tolerances can reach ±0.01 mm. This is not a blanket tolerance for every dimension or product. Engineering must review the geometry, material, datum scheme and inspection method, then define measurable drawing requirements and supporting evidence.
faqs.intent: 核验高频结构公差能力及适用条件
faqs.snippet: 约 45 词条件式答案；先给可达数值，再说明结构、测量和图纸条件

faqs.question: How is plating thickness controlled for RF components?
faqs.answer: For suitable designs above 60 GHz, plating-thickness control can reach 1 μm, depending on structure and verification. Buyers should specify functional surfaces and acceptance criteria, then agree how thickness and related performance will be recorded. The figure is not a universal guarantee for every coating or component.
faqs.intent: 评估高频镀层控制能力及验证边界
faqs.snippet: 约 50 词条件与证据型答案，避免将 1 μm 扩大为统一保证

faqs.question: How are machining, assembly and RF testing connected?
faqs.answer: Machining and surface records should connect to drawing revisions and critical characteristics; assembly and testing should connect to the corresponding build or lot. Applicable VNA, PIM, reliability or matrix-switch tests then provide performance evidence. Exact inspections and coverage are agreed by product and project, not assumed universally.
faqs.intent: 确认机加工到射频测试的追溯与验证方式
faqs.snippet: 约 45 词流程型答案；用加工记录、装配和测试证据说明链路

faqs.question: Does 500,000+ annual capacity guarantee my production lead time?
faqs.answer: No. The 500,000+ figure is public annual capacity, not a delivery guarantee for any part. Production lead time must be assessed from drawings, quantity, process route, verification requirements and available capacity. Approximately two weeks is only a reference for applicable prototypes, not a general prototype or production promise.
faqs.intent: 判断产能数字能否直接转化为交期承诺
faqs.snippet: 约 50 词误解纠正答案；区分年产能、打样参考与量产交期

faqs.question: What evidence should I request before a factory audit?
faqs.answer: Request a relevant equipment list, drawing-to-process flow, inspection and calibration records, sample test reports, and lot or serial traceability where applicable. Sensitive customer information should be redacted. Audit scope, evidence access and any on-site agenda should be agreed for the project rather than inferred from machine count alone.
faqs.intent: 准备工厂审核证据并控制敏感信息披露
faqs.snippet: 约 45 词清单式答案；列出设备、流程、检验、测试和追溯证据

faqs.question: Where can I find RFQ templates, guides and technical documents?
faqs.answer: Start with the resource hub and choose a task: selection guides, RFQ preparation, quality evidence or engineering documents. Filter by product family, then follow the linked guide or document route. Public datasheets remain directly accessible; project drawings, S-parameter files and reports follow project-specific availability and disclosure requirements.
faqs.intent: 按任务定位指南、模板和技术文件
faqs.snippet: 约 50 词导航式答案；列出四类任务与公开或申请边界

faqs.question: Do I need to submit contact details to download every resource?
faqs.answer: No. Core checklists, selection explanations and public datasheets should remain useful without a generic gated PDF. Controlled drawings, S-parameter files or project-specific reports may require an engineering request. Availability and disclosure conditions depend on the document and project rather than a blanket download rule.
faqs.intent: 确认资料是否被强制留资或设通用下载门槛
faqs.snippet: 约 45 词规则型答案；区分公开实用内容与项目受控资料

faqs.question: Can I request an evaluation before all specifications are final?
faqs.answer: Yes. Provide the known frequency range, target performance, mechanical constraints and current uncertainties. Engineering can identify missing inputs and evaluate feasibility. A complete RFQ can receive initial engineering feedback in about 24 hours; that response is not a formal quotation or a prototype or production lead-time guarantee.
faqs.intent: 参数未完整时判断能否先评估及响应边界
faqs.snippet: 约 50 词条件式答案；区分缺失项评估、初步反馈、报价和交期

faqs.question: How do I request drawings, S-parameter files or test reports?
faqs.answer: Identify the product or custom project, required file type, frequency range and intended use. Public datasheets can be accessed directly, while controlled drawings, S-parameter data and sample reports depend on project applicability and agreed disclosure conditions. Do not assume every document exists for every model.
faqs.intent: 获取项目图纸、S 参数或测试报告并理解适用范围
faqs.snippet: 约 45 词操作型答案；列出产品、文件类型、频段和用途输入

faqs.question: Which resource should I use before submitting a custom RFQ?
faqs.answer: Use the RFQ guide when specifications or drawings are mostly ready, because it maps required RF, mechanical, environmental and quantity inputs. Use Insights first when the topology or product family is uncertain, then move to the relevant product page. Submit the completed RFQ for initial engineering feedback, not an automatic quote.

faqs.question: Which RF engineering guide should I read first?
faqs.answer: Choose by task rather than publication date. Start with a selection guide when topology is uncertain, a test-report guide when reviewing evidence, or the RFQ guide when specifications are mostly ready. Each article should provide comparison criteria, measurement conditions and a link to the relevant product family.
faqs.intent: 按当前任务选择合适的技术指南
faqs.snippet: 约 45 词语义列表答案；按选型、验证和询价三种任务给路径

faqs.question: What is the difference between a duplexer and a diplexer?
faqs.answer: A duplexer separates transmit and receive paths so they can share an antenna or port. A diplexer separates or combines different frequency bands. The suitable architecture depends on band plan, port definitions, isolation, insertion loss and power. Use the comparison guide, then submit the band plan through the combiner pathway.
faqs.intent: 理解 duplexer 与 diplexer 差异并进入 band-plan 选型
faqs.snippet: 约 50 词定义加选型条件；承接实测 SV=36 的信息型需求

faqs.question: How should a low PIM design guide support product selection?
faqs.answer: It should connect PIM targets to frequency, power, connector, material, surface and test conditions rather than present a universal rating. Readers should record the applicable configuration and request supporting PIM evidence. Low PIM performance must be assessed for the specific model and conditions, not generalized across all products.
faqs.intent: 按型号与测试条件理解和验证低 PIM 选型
faqs.snippet: 约 45 词条件型答案；列出频率、功率、连接器、材料、表面和测试条件

faqs.question: What should I look for in an RF test report guide?
faqs.answer: Look for explanations of test setup, calibration, frequency range, acceptance limits and sample or lot identification. VNA curves, PIM results, reliability tests and matrix-switch automation answer different questions. Coverage must be defined for the applicable product and metric; a sample report shows evidence format, not a universal result.
faqs.intent: 读懂 VNA、PIM 和可靠性报告并核对覆盖范围
faqs.snippet: 约 50 词核对清单答案；突出设置、校准、限值、样本与批次字段

faqs.question: Can an engineering guide replace a custom RFQ review?
faqs.answer: No. A guide helps define topology, specifications and evidence needs, but feasibility still depends on the actual band plan, mechanical envelope, environment and validation requirements. Submit those inputs for review. A complete RFQ can receive initial engineering feedback in about 24 hours, not an automatic quotation or lead-time commitment.
faqs.intent: 区分自学指南与定制工程评审、报价和交期
faqs.snippet: 约 50 词边界型答案；先回答不能替代，再说明输入和响应边界

faqs.question: What information is required for a custom RF filter RFQ?
faqs.answer: Provide frequency range and bandwidth, insertion loss, return loss, rejection or isolation, power, PIM where applicable, impedance, connectors, mechanical envelope, environment, quantity and verification needs. Mark unknown items as TBD so engineering can identify gaps instead of treating a model number as a complete specification.

faqs.snippet: 约 50 词清单答案；按 RF、机械、环境、数量和验证分组

faqs.question: Can SONNE evaluate a project before every parameter is final?
faqs.answer: Yes. Submit the known frequency range, target performance, mechanical constraints and open questions. Engineering can identify missing inputs and discuss feasibility before the specification is final. Initial engineering feedback is distinct from a formal quote, and prototype or production timing still depends on the agreed scope and requirements.
faqs.intent: 参数未冻结时寻求初步可行性评估
faqs.snippet: 约 45 词流程答案；区分缺失项识别、初步反馈、报价和时间评估

faqs.question: Does a 24-hour response include a quotation and lead time?
faqs.answer: No. Approximately 24 hours refers to initial engineering feedback after a complete RFQ. It may clarify feasibility, missing inputs or next steps. Quotation and delivery timing require further review of drawings, quantities, processes, verification and capacity, so they are not guaranteed by the initial-response statement.
faqs.intent: 确认 24 小时响应与报价、交期的区别
faqs.snippet: 约 45 词误解纠正答案；把初步工程反馈与报价和交期明确分开

faqs.question: How are prototype and production lead times estimated?
faqs.answer: The approximately two-week figure is only a reference for applicable prototype projects, not a general promise. Production lead time depends on drawings, quantities, process route, verification requirements and available capacity. Confirm timing after engineering and commercial review rather than deriving it from annual capacity or a prototype example.
faqs.intent: 理解打样参考与量产交期的项目评估条件
faqs.snippet: 约 45 词条件式答案；明确打样参考与图纸、数量、工艺和产能评估

faqs.question: Can drawings be reviewed under an NDA?
faqs.answer: Confidentiality scope and NDA terms must be agreed for the specific project. Start with a non-confidential overview where practical, then exchange controlled drawings through the agreed route. Do not assume a blanket NDA, disclosure scope or unrestricted file distribution before the parties confirm the applicable terms.

faqs.question: What frequency range can SONNE support?
faqs.answer: Core production covers DC to 40 GHz. Selected custom microwave and waveguide projects can reach 110 GHz, depending on topology and verification. This is not a universal range for every product. Submit frequency bands, interfaces, mechanical constraints and required test evidence for project-specific engineering review.
faqs.intent: 确认标准频段与定制高频能力的适用边界
faqs.snippet: 约 45 词直接答案；DC–40 GHz 与选定定制可达 110 GHz 分开表述

faqs.question: What is the MOQ for custom RF components?
faqs.answer: There is no universal MOQ across product lines. MOQ depends on the product family, customization, process route and project quantity. The public MOQ 50+ statement applies only where specified for the IBS/DAS line, not all SONNE products. Submit drawings or specifications and quantities for project confirmation.
faqs.intent: 了解 MOQ 是否统一以及按项目确认的依据
faqs.snippet: 约 45 词边界型答案；明确 IBS/DAS 限定与产品、工艺和数量条件

faqs.question: How quickly can I receive feedback, a quote and delivery?
faqs.answer: A complete RFQ can usually receive initial engineering feedback in about 24 hours. This is not a quotation or delivery guarantee. Prototypes in approximately two weeks are only a reference where applicable. Production timing is assessed from drawings, quantities, processes, verification requirements and available capacity.
faqs.intent: 区分初步反馈、正式报价、打样与量产交期
faqs.snippet: 约 50 词流程型答案；分别说明初步反馈、打样参考与量产评估

faqs.question: Can custom drawings be protected by an NDA?
faqs.answer: Confidentiality scope and NDA terms must be agreed for the specific project. Begin with a non-confidential overview where practical, then share controlled drawings through the agreed route. Do not assume unrestricted disclosure or a blanket NDA. Define recipients, permitted use and handling requirements before exchanging sensitive design files.
faqs.intent: 提交定制图纸前确认 NDA 和披露范围
faqs.snippet: 约 45 词流程答案；说明项目协商和受控披露，不作统一 NDA 保证

faqs.question: How are quality problems and after-sales issues handled?
faqs.answer: Report the order, lot or serial identification, measured evidence and operating conditions so engineering can review the issue and agree containment or corrective action. Applicable VNA, PIM or reliability evidence should support the analysis. Warranty and RMA scope, timing and remedies must be defined per project agreement, not assumed as a blanket policy.
faqs.intent: 了解质量异常分析、追溯和售后处理边界
faqs.snippet: 约 50 词证据流程答案；涵盖识别、测试证据、处置和项目级质保/RMA
